cs.t: I have the same interests and concerns.  The older I get, the more injuries and problems I develop.  Currently, I need my Kinesis Classic keyboard, my Logitech mouse, my eye-level monitor, and my excellent Steelcase chair. I believe that I could get by with a less ergonomic system if I limited myself to part-time work (say, four to six hours per day) and had ample time to walk around.  I've found nothing better for back/neck problems than a good 15 - 30 minute walk, focusing on posture.  Also, I would find something like a more powerful iPad, on a stand, with a nice Bluetooth keyboard to be much, much more valuable than a laptop, and it should still be very space efficient.
